methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Virginia's AI challenge isn't data centers. It's small-business adoption | Guest column - Richmond Times-Dispatch
signals.signal_reading: Framing the challenge as small-business adoption rather than infrastructure suggests shallow engagement statewide, where AI remains concentrated in data centers serving external customers rather than distributed across Virginia's economy.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - roanoke.edu
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents institutional investment in deep capability building outside NoVA, potentially creating a regional peer learning network that could distribute AI fluency beyond metro hubs.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops targeting technology gap closure signal grassroots knowledge distribution in Hampton Roads, creating potential for broad-based skill development through accessible peer learning rather than platform dependency.

signals.title: Appalachian Power sees ‘explosive’ growth from data centers, other big customers
signals.signal_reading: Appalachian Power's data center growth in historically underserved regions creates infrastructure concentration without evidence of local capability development, reinforcing extractive rather than distributive AI economics.

signals.title: Google to invest millions for Virginia workforce development amid data center growth - WRIC ABC 8News
signals.signal_reading: Google's workforce development investment tied to data center expansion suggests corporate-led, platform-mediated skill building that may produce broad but shallow adoption rather than independent regional AI capability.
